name: Riya Sharma
text: Booked a 6am Innova to Mumbai. Driver was on time, AC was proper, and the fare matched the search - no extra at the gate.

name: Arjun Deshmukh
text: Shared a sedan with two others. Smooth highway, verified profile, and we split fuel and tolls fairly. Booking again for Diwali.

name: Ananya Patil
text: Sunday evening hop back to Pune. Shared live location with my parents and reached before the time on the ticket.
